title: Finite-support diagram for open counits under a qcqs direct image
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $p:V\to T$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, $i:W\hookrightarrow T$ an open immersion, $M$ a constant-$A$ module sheaf on $V\times_TW$, and $Q\to T$ an affine pro-etale test object. Let $k:V\times_TW\to V$, $F=p_*k_!M$, and $c:i_!i^*F\to F$ the specified intrinsic counit. For each $y\in F(Q)$ there exist a quasi-compact open $O\subseteq Q$ contained in $Q\times_TW$, a module sheaf $M_0$ on $(V\times_TQ)\times_QO$, and $y_0\in F_0(Q)$, where $p_Q:V\times_TQ\to Q$, $k_0:(V\times_TQ)\times_QO\to V\times_TQ$, $F_0=p_{Q,*}k_{0,!}M_0$. If $c_0:O_!O^*F_0\to F_0$ is the intrinsic counit, there exist additive group homomorphisms $a:\Gamma(Q,O_!O^*F_0)\to(i_!i^*F)(Q)$ and $b:\Gamma(Q,F_0)\to F(Q)$ such that $c_Q(a(x))=b((c_0)_Q(x))$ for all $x$ and $b(y_0)=y$. No surjectivity of either counit is asserted.

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AG; the affine support argument recorded in Steps 3--11 of lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison

proof.text: Localize at the affine pro-etale test object Q. Weakly etale localization and open-extension base change identify the target section with a section of the extension by zero on V times_T Q. This scheme is quasi-compact and quasi-separated since p is qcqs and Q is affine.

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AG; the affine support argument recorded in Steps 3--11 of lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison

proof.text: The sheafification unit is locally surjective. The pro-etale covering condition gives finitely many affine representatives over this qcqs scheme. Every nonzero zero-extension representative factors through the pulled-back open. Its quasi-compact image in Q lies in the inverse image of W; cover these finitely many images by finitely many principal opens inside that open. Their union O is quasi-compact. Empty supports give O empty. Restrict the localized M to the inverse image of O to obtain M_0.

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AG; the affine support argument recorded in Steps 3--11 of lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison

proof.text: Lift the local representatives to the smaller extension by zero, taking zero on all other representatives. The smaller-to-larger extension map is monic by presheaf zero extension and exact sheafification, so these lifts agree on overlaps and glue. Push forward the smaller-open inclusion and apply the localization comparison to obtain an additive section map b and y_0 with b(y_0)=y.

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AG; the affine support argument recorded in Steps 3--11 of lem-exc-proetale-proper-open-sheaf-comparison

proof.text: Extend the restriction of the smaller-open inclusion from O into the inverse image of W, then use localization, to construct the additive map a on the sources of the counits. Adjunction transposition, naturality and the triangle identities show that c(a(x))=b(c_0(x)) for every x. This is a commuting square, with no lifting or surjectivity assertion about c or c_0. Properness has not been used.

lean.statement:
theorem sfOpenCounit_finiteSupportDiagram {V W T : Scheme.{u}} (p : V ⟶ T)
    [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p] (i : W ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (M : proEtaleRingModules (pullback p i)
      (proEtaleConstantRing (pullback p i) A)) (Q : T.ProEt) [IsAffine Q.left] :
    let F := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero (pullback.fst p i) A ⋙
      proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage p A).obj M
    let c := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZeroAdjunction i A).counit.app F
    ∀ y : F.val.obj (op Q),
      ∃ (O : Q.left.Opens) (_ : IsCompact (O : Set Q.left))
        (_ : (O : Set Q.left) ⊆ Q.hom ⁻¹' Set.range i)
        (M₀ : proEtaleRingModules (pullback (pullback.snd p Q.hom) O.ι)
          (proEtaleConstantRing (pullback (pullback.snd p Q.hom) O.ι) A)),
        let F₀ := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd p Q.hom) O.ι) A ⋙
            proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage (pullback.snd p Q.hom) A).obj M₀
        let c₀ := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZeroAdjunction O.ι A).counit.app F₀
        ∃ (a : ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero O.ι A).obj
            ((sfIntrinsicOpenRestriction O.ι A).obj F₀)).val.obj (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 Q.left))) →+
              ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero i A).obj
                ((sfIntrinsicOpenRestriction i A).obj F)).val.obj (op Q))
          (b : F₀.val.obj (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 Q.left))) →+ F.val.obj (op Q))
          (y₀ : F₀.val.obj (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 Q.left)))),
          (∀ x, c.val.app (op Q) (a x) =
            b (c₀.val.app (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 Q.left))) x)) ∧ b y₀ = y
